bonus.description: The entry quantity is the performance bonus for the period; it is additional wages. Practical treatment: SSS/MPF/EC and HDMF use ordinary wages; PHIC uses basic salary; 13th month and Christmas bonus are outside all four monthly bases. The SSS IRR expressly excludes Christmas bonus and does not name 13th month. WTAX uses final gross and includes both in the 90,000 aggregate benefits pool. If a written SSS ruling requires 13th-month inclusion, change only the SSS checkpoint routing.

references.title: Labor Code art.100; company policy or CBA: a performance bonus is a contractual benefit, not a statutory wage.

CHRISTMAS_BONUS.description: The entry quantity is the separately promised Christmas bonus for the period; it is additional wages, never the de minimis Christmas gift. Practical treatment: SSS/MPF/EC and HDMF use ordinary wages; PHIC uses basic salary; 13th month and Christmas bonus are outside all four monthly bases. The SSS IRR expressly excludes Christmas bonus and does not name 13th month. WTAX uses final gross and includes both in the 90,000 aggregate benefits pool. If a written SSS ruling requires 13th-month inclusion, change only the SSS checkpoint routing.

references.title: Labor Code art.100; company policy or CBA: a Christmas bonus promised separately from the statutory 13th-month pay is a contractual benefit. SSS IRR (2019) Rule 12 s.6(iii) excludes a Christmas bonus from the monthly salary credit; NIRC s.32(B)(7)(e) and RR 11-2018 s.2.78.1(B)(11) include it in the PHP90,000 aggregate benefits pool.

13th-month basic includes eligible basic salary differentials and maternity salary differential. Required earning_year attributes this actual amount to its earned calendar year independently of cash payment year; split cross-year amounts. classification_reference identifies the underlying wage/leave adjustment evidence.

BACKPAY_BASIC.description: Basic salary owed for past periods and paid now, at the amount entered. It is taxable pay of the month it is paid and counts toward 13th-month pay for the year it was earned.

references.title: Labor Code art.100; RA 6727 wage orders: an unpaid contractual allowance owed for past periods is back pay.

BACKPAY_DUTY_ALLOWANCE.description: A contract allowance owed for past periods and paid now, at the amount entered. It is taxable pay of the month it is paid.

references.title: Labor Code art.100; RA 6727 wage orders: an unpaid wage adjustment owed for past periods is back pay.

BACKPAY_ADD_WAGES.description: A wage adjustment owed for past periods and paid now, at the amount entered. It is taxable pay of the month it is paid.

references.title: SSS/Pag-IBIG remuneration and WTAX supplementary compensation unchanged.13th-month treatment is factual: direct personal-sales commissions forming salary are included (Philippine Duplicators); productivity/profit-sharing/overriding commissions are excluded unless integrated into basic by agreement/practice. Required commission_basis and classification_reference preserve that genuine classification; a blanket commission exclusion is incorrect. Reyes vNLRC,GR160233,8August2007.

COMMISSION.description: A commission, at the amount entered. It is wages for SSS and Pag-IBIG and is taxed with the month's pay; a sales commission that forms part of salary also counts toward 13th-month pay.

THIRTEENTH_MONTH_PAY.description: 13th-month pay at the amount entered: at least one twelfth of the basic salary earned in the calendar year, paid by 24 December (PD 851). Outside the SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG bases; tax-free with other benefits up to ₱90,000 a year.

references.title: PD851/DOLE2024 Handbook ch.13 C-H; Reyes GR160233; PAL GR142399. Automatic calculation uses original payroll_history and ordered current.priced_lines: signed eligible basic by earning_year, documented personal-sales/integrated components, less actual13th/evidenced equivalent grants only for matching entitlement_year. Current component dependencies order maternity/basic-backpay/commission and other selected awards before13th regardless input order. HR supplies dated source-completeness and confirmed attendance/salary-through facts, not a calculated total. Year-end daily additional unpriced paid days multiply an unchanged captured daily rate. Future unknown records, missing original attribution/classification or unsupported rate changes require the existing dated reviewed residual-base fallback or refuse. A later change requires a differential. Generic gifts and separately promised CBA Christmas bonuses never become automatic credits.

SEPARATION_PAY.description: The entry quantity is the separation amount; the recorded termination cause and service remain the legal basis.

references.title: Labor Code art.298: one month’s pay or one month per year of service, whichever is higher, on termination for installation of labour-saving devices or redundancy; art.298–299: half a month per year or one month, whichever is higher, on retrenchment, closure not due to serious losses, or disease. A fraction of at least six months counts as a year. Labor Code arts.298–299: one month’s pay per year of service (redundancy, the only authorised cause the exit reasons distinguish; a fraction of at least six months counts as a year), never less than one month. Tax: exempt under NIRC s.32(B)(6)(b) as pay for a cause beyond the employee’s control (redundancy or retrenchment), so the class counts toward nothing and no withholding scheme reads it. the exit fact `termination_cause` chooses the award — labour-saving devices or redundancy one month a year (art.298); retrenchment, a closure not due to serious losses, or disease half a month a year (arts.298–299); a closure due to serious business losses owes none (art.298: the half-month award is for closures "not due to serious business losses"). A kasambahay's disease is a just cause under RA 10361 s.34(f) with no separation pay. Years of service are `round(service_months / 12, 1, HALF_UP)`: a fraction of at least six months counts as a year (corrected in every version from a tenth-of-a-year rounding); the month’s pay is the contract’s monthly wage, basic plus fixed allowances (`terms.monthly_wage`). Causes are the exit fact `termination_cause` (customer input), incl. a security guard or contractor’s worker without assignment (half a month a year) and an impossible reinstatement (a month a year), DOLE Handbook 2024 ch.14 §C. A bona fide suspension of operations beyond six months (Labor Code art.301; Omnibus Rules Book VI Rule I s.12 as amended by DOLE DO 215-20, https://web.archive.org/web/2021id_/https://www.dole.gov.ph/php_assets/uploads/2020/10/DO-215-20-Rule-Amending-Section-12-of-Rule-I-Rules-Implementing-Book-VI-of-the-Labor-Code-on-Suspension-of-Employment-Relationship.pdf, read 2026-10-07: the relationship is suspended for not more than six months, extendable by six in a declared national emergency; an employee retrenched before or after the extension is "entitled to separation pay as prescribed by the Labor Code", and "the first six (6) months of suspension of employment shall be included in the computation") is the cause `SUSPENSION_OVER_SIX_MONTHS`: the retrenchment award, half a month a year, at least a month, the suspension months counting as service.

RA 9262 s.8(g): a protection order may direct the respondent to provide support, and notwithstanding other laws to the contrary the court orders an appropriate percentage of the respondent's income or salary withheld regularly by the employer and automatically remitted directly to the woman; failure to withhold or remit, or delay without justifiable cause, makes the employer liable for indirect contempt. Added in place 2026-09-29 in every version (ML-2, a transcription omission: RA 9262 predates every version). The percentage is the court's, so the employer deducts exactly the amount the served order fixes for the period, entered by HR with the order as evidence. Owner rule 2026-09-28: the Act is silent on how the employer books the withholding; default a net-pay deduction after every statutory line, touching no SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG or withholding base, because the support is paid out of the respondent's own compensation. Remittance to the payee is an external payment (obligation PROTECTION_ORDER_SUPPORT_WITHHOLDING).

PROTECTION_ORDER_SUPPORT.description: Support a protection order directs the employer to withhold from the employee's pay and remit to the woman it protects, deducted from net pay at the amount the order fixes (RA 9262 s.8(g)).

RETIREMENT_PAY.description: The entry quantity is the RA 7641 retirement amount; age, service and establishment exemptions gate the definition. A retirement plan does not: where it pays less than RA 7641, this class pays the difference (DOLE Handbook 2024 ch.15 §E).

references.title: RA 7641 (Labor Code art.302): an employee retiring at 60 to 65 after at least five years’ service, with no retirement plan, is paid half a month’s salary for every year of service — 22.5 days: fifteen days, the five-day service incentive leave and one twelfth of the 13th-month pay — a fraction of at least six months counting as a year. RA 7641 (Labor Code art.302): optional retirement from sixty and compulsory at sixty-five, after five years’ service — a person retiring past sixty-five is inside it; retail, service and agricultural establishments of not more than ten workers are outside (`company.small_establishment`). One-half month salary is 22.5 days of the daily rate, the daily rate being the monthly basic on the person’s own factor (365 for the monthly-paid, 313 on a six-day week, 261 on five). Tax: the statutory benefit is exempt under NIRC s.32(B)(6)(a), which is why this class pays the RA 7641 minimum only — any excess over it under a company plan would be tested against RA 4917 (age 50, ten years’ service, BIR-qualified plan). the exemption is its own required entity fact, `company.retirement_exempt_establishment` — RA 7641 exempts retail, service and agricultural establishments of not more than ten employees, a different class from the SIL exemption of any establishment regularly employing fewer than ten (`small_establishment`); a small manufacturer owes retirement pay. The daily rate is the monthly basic × 12 ÷ the contract factor (365 − 52 × (7 − `normal_days_per_week`); 313 on the six-day default); the exemption is the entity fact `retirement_exempt_establishment`. Handbook ch.15 §B: retirement "upon reaching the age of 60 years or more but not beyond 65 years". RA 8558 and RA 10757: an underground or surface mine worker (contract-term fact `mine_worker`, customer input) retires from fifty, compulsorily at sixty, after five years as a mine worker. Past the compulsory age: sixty-five (sixty for a mine worker) makes retirement compulsory; it does not forfeit the RA 7641 benefit, so an employee kept on and retired later is paid it.

RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3) as amended by RR 11-2018 (and RR 4-2025, published 30 January 2025 and in force 14 February 2025, for uniforms and achievement awards) (e): uniform and clothing allowance to ₱7,000 a year: a de minimis benefit, outside compensation to the ceiling; the excess is an ‘other benefit’ inside the ₱90,000 exclusion (NIRC s.32(B)(7)(e)) — the DE_MINIMIS_UNIFORM checkpoint, capped over the calendar year.

UNIFORM_ALLOWANCE.description: A uniform and clothing allowance, at the amount entered. It is tax-free up to ₱7,000 a year; anything above counts toward the ₱90,000 yearly limit on other benefits (RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3)(e)).

references.title: RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3) as amended by RR 11-2018 (and RR 4-2025, published 30 January 2025 and in force 14 February 2025, for uniforms and achievement awards) (f): actual medical assistance (medical allowance, annual check-up, maternity assistance, routine consultations) to ₱10,000 a year: a de minimis benefit, outside compensation to the ceiling; the excess is an ‘other benefit’ inside the ₱90,000 exclusion (NIRC s.32(B)(7)(e)) — the DE_MINIMIS_MEDICAL checkpoint, capped over the calendar year.

MEDICAL_ASSISTANCE.description: Medical assistance to the employee, such as a medical allowance, yearly check-up or maternity assistance, at the amount entered. It is tax-free up to ₱10,000 a year; anything above counts toward the ₱90,000 yearly limit on other benefits (RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3)(f)).

references.title: RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3) as amended by RR 11-2018 (and RR 4-2025, published 30 January 2025 and in force 14 February 2025, for uniforms and achievement awards) (h): achievement awards for length of service or safety, in any form, under a written non-discriminatory plan, to ₱10,000 a year: a de minimis benefit, outside compensation to the ceiling; the excess is an ‘other benefit’ inside the ₱90,000 exclusion (NIRC s.32(B)(7)(e)) — the DE_MINIMIS_AWARD checkpoint, capped over the calendar year.

ACHIEVEMENT_AWARD.description: An award for length of service or safety under a written plan, at the amount entered. It is tax-free up to ₱10,000 a year; anything above counts toward the ₱90,000 yearly limit on other benefits (RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3)(h)).

references.title: RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3) as amended by RR 11-2018 (and RR 4-2025, published 30 January 2025 and in force 14 February 2025, for uniforms and achievement awards) (i): Christmas and major anniversary gifts to ₱5,000 a year: a de minimis benefit, outside compensation to the ceiling; the excess is an ‘other benefit’ inside the ₱90,000 exclusion (NIRC s.32(B)(7)(e)) — the DE_MINIMIS_GIFT checkpoint, capped over the calendar year.

CHRISTMAS_GIFT.description: A Christmas or major anniversary gift, at the amount entered. It is tax-free up to ₱5,000 a year; anything above counts toward the ₱90,000 yearly limit on other benefits (RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3)(i)).

references.title: RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3) as amended by RR 11-2018 (and RR 4-2025, published 30 January 2025 and in force 14 February 2025, for uniforms and achievement awards) (k): benefits under a CBA and a productivity incentive scheme, combined, to ₱10,000 a year: a de minimis benefit, outside compensation to the ceiling; the excess is an ‘other benefit’ inside the ₱90,000 exclusion (NIRC s.32(B)(7)(e)) — the DE_MINIMIS_CBA checkpoint, capped over the calendar year.

CBA_PRODUCTIVITY.description: A benefit under a collective bargaining agreement or a productivity incentive scheme, at the amount entered. It is tax-free up to ₱10,000 a year for the two together; anything above counts toward the ₱90,000 yearly limit on other benefits (RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3)(k)).

references.title: RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3) as amended by RR 11-2018 (and RR 4-2025, published 30 January 2025 and in force 14 February 2025, for uniforms and achievement awards) (j): a daily meal allowance for overtime work or a night/graveyard shift is de minimis to 25% of the region’s basic minimum wage for each such day (the region’s monthly figure × 12 ÷ 313 is the daily wage the order states). The ceiling bounds the exemption, never the pay: the class pays what the employer keyed, whole. the DE_MINIMIS_OT_MEAL checkpoint is exempt to 25% × the daily minimum wage × the days (the run’s dates with overtime or night-window hours); the excess is an ‘other benefit’ inside the ₱90,000 exclusion (RR 11-2018 s.2.78.1(A)(3) closing paragraph; RMC 50-2018: “benefits given in excess of the maximum amount allowed as de minimis benefits shall be included as part of ‘other benefits’”).

OT_MEAL_ALLOWANCE.description: A meal allowance for a day of overtime or night-shift work, at the amount entered. It is tax-free up to 25% of the region's daily minimum wage for each such day; anything above counts toward the ₱90,000 yearly limit on other benefits (RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3)(j)).

KASAMBAHAY_FORFEITURE.description: The entry quantity is the unpaid salary; the deduction is capped at fifteen days at the recorded daily rate.

references.title: RA 10361 s.32: a domestic worker who leaves without justifiable reason forfeits unpaid salary of no more than fifteen days. This NET deduction is capped by the final payslip’s unpaid salary; the thirteenth-month pay and leave conversion are not salary for this cap. The day is the monthly wage × 12 ÷ the contract factor (365 − 52 × (7 − `normal_days_per_week`); 313 on the six-day default). The entry amount is the unpaid salary; at most fifteen days of it is forfeited.

KASAMBAHAY_FORFEITURE.conversion:
const daily = ctx.day_rate;
return Math.min(ctx.entry.quantity, ctx.lookup.forfeiture_days * daily);

KASAMBAHAY_INDEMNITY.description: The entry quantity records the indemnity; the amount is fifteen days at the recorded daily rate.

references.title: RA 10361 s.32: "If the domestic worker is unjustly dismissed, the domestic worker shall be paid the compensation already earned plus the equivalent of fifteen (15) days work by way of indemnity". The Act is silent on the day: fifteen of the version’s ordinary days (`terms.ordinary_day`, the monthly basic over `ordinary_divisor_days`), the day every other PH day-rate reads. Tax: a separation for a cause beyond the employee’s control, NIRC s.32(B)(6)(b), so the class counts toward nothing, like SEPARATION_PAY. The pay-request person context evaluates the version’s ordinary divisor and roster week on the event date. The day is the monthly wage × 12 ÷ the contract factor (365 − 52 × (7 − `normal_days_per_week`); 313 on the six-day default).

KASAMBAHAY_INDEMNITY.conversion:
const daily = ctx.day_rate;
return ctx.lookup.indemnity_days * daily;

references.title: RA 11199, RA 11223, RA 9679 and NIRC s.58: correction of a prior statutory contribution or withholding remittance.

STATUTORY_ADJUSTMENT.description: A statutory contribution or tax correction decided outside the run, deducted from pay at the amount entered; the statutory schemes are not re-run.

references.title: A statutory correction is an adhoc entry on this item. A year that comes out overpaid raises an obligation for the HR controller to enter it.

STATUTORY_REFUND.description: Tax or a contribution overpaid, paid back to the employee. The entry quantity is the refund; the statutory schemes are not re-run.

MATERNITY_SALARY_DIFFERENTIAL.description: The entry quantity is the full salary for the leave less the SSS maternity benefit.

references.title: RA 11210 s.5(c) and its IRR Rule VI: the employer pays the difference between the full salary and the SSS maternity benefit, unless exempt — a distressed establishment, a retail or service establishment of ten or fewer, a micro business, or one already paying the equivalent (entity fact `maternity_differential_exempt`, customer input). Customer input: `entry.amount`, the full salary for the leave less the SSS benefit. Exempt from withholding (RMC 105-2019: payments of benefits under the SSS law, RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(B)(1)(e)), so it counts toward no scheme.

13th-month basic includes eligible basic salary differentials and maternity salary differential. Required earning_year attributes this actual amount to its earned calendar year independently of cash payment year; split cross-year amounts. classification_reference identifies the underlying wage/leave adjustment evidence.

NIRC s.24(A)(2); RR 11-2018 s.2.78.1(B)(13): hazard pay is compensation (SSS, Pag-IBIG) that a minimum wage earner receives exempt (the STATUTORY_WAGES checkpoint). Customer input: the amount the employer’s hazard-pay plan pays.

HAZARD_PAY.description: Hazard pay under the employer's plan, at the amount entered. It is wages for SSS and Pag-IBIG, and a minimum wage earner receives it tax-free (RR 11-2018 s.2.78.1(B)(13)).

references.title: Labor Code arts.93-94: the statutory premium is a floor; an employer may pay more, and what it pays for work is wages.

PREMIUM_PAY.description: Premium pay for a day worked that the employer pays above what the day's own row computes (a higher rate for one holiday or rest day). It is wages of the period, like the premium it tops up.

references.title: Labor Code art.96 as amended by RA 11360 s.1: service charges collected by hotels, restaurants and similar establishments are distributed completely and equally among the covered workers, managerial employees excepted; they are not counted toward the minimum wage. Customer input: the employee’s equal share of the period’s collections. Compensation for SSS, Pag-IBIG and WTAX.

SERVICE_CHARGE_SHARE.description: The employee's equal share of the service charges a hotel, restaurant or similar establishment collects, at the amount entered. It does not count toward the minimum wage (Labor Code art.96).

references.title: Labor Code art.113(b) and the check-off provisions (arts.250(o), 259(e) as renumbered): deducted only with the employee’s written authorisation (`evidence` REQUIRED); NIRC s.32(B)(7)(f) and RR 11-2018 s.2.78.1(B)(12): excluded from taxable compensation (the UNION_DUES checkpoint, which WTAX subtracts).

UNION_DUES.description: Union dues deducted from pay with the employee's written authorisation, at the amount entered. They are taken off taxable pay (Labor Code art.113(b); NIRC s.32(B)(7)(f)).

references.title: RA 9679 s.7: an employee may elect to contribute above the mandatory share; only the mandatory employee share is excluded from compensation (NIRC s.32(B)(7)(f)), so the voluntary amount is deducted after tax. Customer input: the elected amount (`evidence` REQUIRED).

HDMF_VOLUNTARY.description: A Pag-IBIG contribution the employee elects to pay above the mandatory share, deducted from net pay after tax at the amount elected (RA 9679 s.7).

references.title: RA 9679 s.7; Pag-IBIG MP2 programme: a voluntary savings deduction on the employee’s election, after tax. Customer input: the elected amount (`evidence` REQUIRED).

HDMF_MP2.description: The employee's voluntary Pag-IBIG MP2 savings, deducted from net pay at the amount the employee elected (RA 9679 s.7).

LOSS_DAMAGE_DEDUCTION.description: The entry quantity is the assessed loss; the deduction is capped at 20% of the period's basic pay.

references.title: Labor Code arts.113–114; Omnibus Rules Implementing the Labor Code Book III Rule VIII s.14: a deduction for loss or damage to the employer’s tools, materials or equipment only where the employee is clearly responsible and was heard (`evidence` REQUIRED), never above the actual loss and "not exceed 20 percent of the employee’s wages in a week" — capped at 20% of the period’s basic. A kasambahay is never charged for loss or damage (RA 10361 s.14). In a month paid at two frequencies (`period.switched`) the period’s basic is the slip’s settled share: the month from `period.month_from` to `period.to` less the earlier slips. Recorded default (weekly cap): Rule VIII s.14(c) limits the deduction to "20 percent of the employee’s wages in a week"; a deduction made on a pay day is read as spread over the period’s weeks, so the cap is 20% of the period’s basic — the sum of 20% of each of its weeks’ wages. An entry above the cap is cut to it (`on_exceed: CAP`); HR enters any remainder in a later period.

FRINGE_BENEFIT.description: The entry quantity is the monetary value of the benefit in kind; it is employer cost only.

references.title: NIRC s.33; RR 11-2018 s.2.33: a benefit in kind (housing, vehicle, membership, …) is priced and settled but adds no pay: for supervisory and managerial staff it is the FBT scheme’s base, for rank-and-file it is taxable compensation (WTAX adds the FRINGE_BENEFIT checkpoint). Customer input: the monetary value under RR 3-98 s.2.33(B).

NIRC s.32(B)(6)(b): only separation pay for a cause beyond the employee’s control (death, sickness, disability, an authorised cause) is excluded; a payment on resignation or under a company plan for any other cause is taxable compensation. Customer input: the amount.

SEPARATION_PAY_TAXABLE.description: Separation pay for a cause within the employee's control, such as resignation, at the amount entered. It is taxable pay (NIRC s.32(B)(6)(b)).

references.title: NIRC s.32(B)(6)(a): retirement benefits under RA 7641, or under a reasonable private plan to an employee of at least fifty with ten years’ service, availed once, are excluded; any other retirement payment is taxable compensation. Customer input: the amount.

RETIREMENT_PAY_TAXABLE.description: A retirement payment that does not meet the conditions for exemption, at the amount entered. It is taxable pay (NIRC s.32(B)(6)(a)).

SSS_SICKNESS_BENEFIT.description: The entry quantity is the SSS-computed sickness benefit advanced by the employer.

references.title: RA 11199 s.14: the employer pays a confined member 90% of the average daily salary credit for each compensable day from the fourth, at most 120 days a year, after the paid sick leave is exhausted, and is reimbursed by SSS; benefits under the SSS law are exempt from withholding (RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(B)(1)(e)). Customer input: the benefit SSS computes (the average daily salary credit needs contributions older than the 12 months the payroll history holds).

SSS_MATERNITY_BENEFIT.description: The entry quantity is the SSS-computed maternity benefit advanced by the employer.

references.title: RA 11199 s.14-A as amended by RA 11210 (https://elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph/thebookshelf/showdocs/2/86333, read 2026-10-07): a member with at least three monthly contributions in the twelve months before the semester of the contingency is paid 100% of her average daily salary credit, advanced in full by the employer within thirty days of the application and reimbursed by SSS; s.8(n)–(p): the average daily salary credit is the six highest monthly salary credits of those twelve months ÷ 180, the semester the two quarters ending in the quarter of the contingency. SSS Maternity Benefit page (https://www.sss.gov.ph/maternity-benefit/, read 2026-10-07): 105 days for a live birth, 120 for a solo parent, 60 for a miscarriage or emergency termination; "The computation of benefits under the Regular SSS Program shall be based on contributions up to 20,000 MSC." The contingency is `entry.occurred_on`, the event `entry.event_kind` and the solo-parent claim `entry.solo_parent_claimed`, as on the maternity leave; each month’s credit is its SSS base charged (`earned.history[].statutory.SSS.base`) on the contribution table’s ₱500 steps, ₱5,000 floor (₱1,000 for a kasambahay) and ₱20,000 Regular SS ceiling. The credits are this employer’s payroll only; contributions paid through an earlier employer count at SSS, so when this payroll holds fewer than three of the twelve months’ credits the class pays the entry amount — customer input: the benefit SSS computes (SSS also applies the three-contribution test there). Exempt from withholding as an SSS benefit (RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(B)(1)(e)).

RETIREMENT_PAY_QUALIFIED_PLAN.description: The entry quantity is the BIR-qualified plan benefit; the plan approval, age, service and once-only election gate the definition.

references.title: NIRC s.32(B)(6)(a) as amended by RA 4917 (https://lawphil.net/statutes/repacts/ra1997/ra_8424_1997.html, read 2026-10-07): excluded from gross income are retirement benefits "received by officials and employees of private firms ... in accordance with a reasonable private benefit plan maintained by the employer: Provided, That the retiring official or employee has been in the service of the same employer for at least ten (10) years and is not less than fifty (50) years of age at the time of his retirement: Provided, further, That the benefits granted under this subparagraph shall be availed of by an official or employee only once". Gated on the entity fact `bir_qualified_retirement_plan` (the plan’s BIR approval), age fifty, 120 months’ service and the employee fact `retirement_plan_exemption_availed` (once in a lifetime); counts toward no tax base. Customer input: the plan benefit. Any other retirement payment is RETIREMENT_PAY_TAXABLE.

references.title: Labor Code art.87; DOLE Handbook on Workers’ Statutory Monetary Benefits 2024 ch.4 §C and ch.1 §A: hours beyond eight a day at 125% of the hourly rate on an ordinary day, 169% on a rest or special day, 195% on a special day that is the rest day or on a double special day, 253.5% on a double special rest day, 260% / 338% on a regular holiday (rest day), 390% / 507% on a double holiday. references.title: Labor Code art.93(a)–(b); DOLE Handbook on Workers’ Statutory Monetary Benefits 2024 ch.3 §D: work on the scheduled rest day is paid at least 130% for its first eight hours. references.title: Labor Code art.94; Omnibus Rules Implementing the Labor Code (https://elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph/thebookshelf/showdocs/2/85819) Book III Rule IV ss.2, 6, 10; DOLE Handbook on Workers’ Statutory Monetary Benefits 2024 ch.2: a daily-paid employee is paid 100% for an unworked regular holiday (a double holiday adds the DOUBLE_HOLIDAY_UNWORKED line), unless on leave without pay on the working day immediately before it — a rest day or non-working day in between is skipped (s.6(c)), and of two successive holidays the second is paid when the first is worked (s.10).

DOLE_TELECOMMUTING_NOTICE.name: Notify the DOLE of a telecommuting program through the Establishment Report System

references.title: DO 237-22 (Revised IRR of RA 11165) s.10 (https://web.archive.org/web/2023id_/https://bwc.dole.gov.ph/images/Issuances/DepartmentOrder/DO_237_22.pdf, read 2026-10-07; supersedes DO 202-19): "The employer shall notify the DOLE of the implementation of telecommuting through the Establishment Report System". The rule names no period: a recorded default due on the program’s start (`starts_on`, else the opening day). Raised when a TELECOMMUTING_PROGRAM case is opened.

DOLE_SUSPENSION_EXTENSION_REPORT.description: Raises the DOLE suspension-extension report task ten days before it takes effect.
DOLE_SUSPENSION_EXTENSION_REPORT.name: Report the extension of a suspension of employment to the DOLE ten days before

references.title: Omnibus Rules Book VI Rule I s.12 as amended by DO 215-20 (https://web.archive.org/web/2021id_/https://www.dole.gov.ph/php_assets/uploads/2020/10/DO-215-20-Rule-Amending-Section-12-of-Rule-I-Rules-Implementing-Book-VI-of-the-Labor-Code-on-Suspension-of-Employment-Relationship.pdf, read 2026-10-07): "the employer shall report to the Department of Labor and Employment, through the Regional Offices, the extension of suspension of employment ten (10) days prior to the effectivity thereof subject to inspection". A suspension of operations within six months (Labor Code art.301) has no DOLE report in the instruments read. Raised when a SUSPENSION_EXTENSION case is opened; the extension’s first day is `starts_on`, else the opening day.

SOLO_PARENT_FLEXIBLE_SCHEDULE.description: Raises the solo-parent flexible-schedule task on the schedule's scheduled start.
SOLO_PARENT_FLEXIBLE_SCHEDULE.name: Provide the solo parent’s flexible work schedule

references.title: RA 8972 s.6 (https://elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph/thebookshelf/showdocs/2/3532, read 2026-10-07): "The employer shall provide for a flexible working schedule for solo parents: Provided, That the same shall not affect individual and company productivity: Provided, further, That any employer may request exemption ... from the DOLE"; s.3(c) as amended by RA 11861 (https://elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph/thebookshelf/showdocs/2/95472) defines the schedule; s.7 as amended by RA 11861 s.6 forbids discrimination and gives solo parents priority for telecommuting. The Act names no period: a recorded default due on the request day. Raised when a SOLO_PARENT_FLEXIBLE_SCHEDULE case is opened (opened_on = the request).

NPC_BREACH_NOTIFICATION.description: Raises the 72-hour NPC and data-subject breach notification task from the date of knowledge.
NPC_BREACH_NOTIFICATION.name: Notify the NPC and the data subjects of a personal data breach within 72 hours

references.title: NPC Circular 16-03 (https://web.archive.org/web/2018id_/http://privacy.gov.ph:80/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/sgd-npc-circular-16-03-personal-data-breach-management.pdf, read 2026-10-07) s.11 (when notification is required), s.17(A): "The Commission shall be notified within seventy-two (72) hours upon knowledge of or the reasonable belief ... that a personal data breach has occurred", s.17(C): the full report "within five (5) days"; s.18(A): data subjects "within seventy-two (72) hours"; RA 10173 s.20(f). Raised when a PERSONAL_DATA_BREACH case is opened (opened_on = the day of knowledge); due three days after.

NPC_BREACH_FULL_REPORT.description: Raises the full NPC breach report task, due eight days from the date the breach became known: five days after the 72-hour notification.
NPC_BREACH_FULL_REPORT.name: Submit the full personal data breach report to the NPC

references.title: NPC Circular 16-03 (https://web.archive.org/web/2018id_/http://privacy.gov.ph:80/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/sgd-npc-circular-16-03-personal-data-breach-management.pdf, read 2026-10-07) s.17(C): "The full report of the personal data breach must be submitted within five (5) days, unless the personal information controller is granted additional time by the Commission". Raised with the notification; due eight days after the day of knowledge (three for the notice, five for the report — recorded default).

SSS_CONTRIBUTION_REMITTANCE.description: Raises the monthly SSS contribution remittance task by the last day of the following month.
SSS_CONTRIBUTION_REMITTANCE.name: SSS contributions (SS, MPF, EC) for the month

references.title: SSS Circular 2019-012 as published on https://www.sss.gov.ph/pay-contribution/: on or before the last day of the month following the applicable month; RA 11199 (https://elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph/thebookshelf/showdocs/2/86333) s.22(a): a late contribution carries a penalty of 2% a month. Recorded default: the calendar day (no next-working-day extension).

PHILHEALTH_PREMIUM_REMITTANCE.description: Raises the monthly PhilHealth premium remittance task by the fifteenth of the following month.
PHILHEALTH_PREMIUM_REMITTANCE.name: PhilHealth premium for the month

references.title: PhilHealth Circular 0001 s.2014: the 11th–15th of the following month for a PhilHealth Employer Number ending 0–4, the 16th–20th for one ending 5–9. Recorded default: an employer without a recorded PEN (entity fact `philhealth_employer_number`) is due on the 15th, the earlier window; interest on missed premiums (UHC Act IRR s.9.2) is not computed.

HDMF_CONTRIBUTION_REMITTANCE.description: Raises the monthly Pag-IBIG contribution remittance task by the fourteenth of the following month.
HDMF_CONTRIBUTION_REMITTANCE.name: Pag-IBIG contributions for the month

references.title: HDMF Circular 275 §E.2, §E.4 (RA 9679 s.7): in the month following the period covered by the first letter of the employer’s name — A–D by the 14th, E–L the 19th, M–Q the 24th, R–Z or a numeral the month’s end; a penalty of 1/10 of 1% a day of delay. Recorded default: due on the 14th, the earliest window.

BIR_1601C_MONTHLY_REMITTANCE.description: Raises the monthly BIR Form 1601-C task by the tenth of the following month, or the fifteenth for December.
BIR_1601C_MONTHLY_REMITTANCE.name: BIR Form 1601-C and the compensation tax withheld

references.title: NIRC s.58(A), s.81; RR 2-98 s.2.58 as amended; BIR Form 1601-C guidelines: on or before the 10th day of the following month, December’s on or before 15 January. Manual filers’ days; an eFPS filer’s later industry-group day is not applied (never later than the law); the s.248 surcharge and s.249 interest are not computed.

BIR_1603Q_FRINGE_BENEFITS.description: Raises the quarterly BIR Form 1603Q fringe-benefit tax task by the last day of the month after the quarter.
BIR_1603Q_FRINGE_BENEFITS.name: BIR Form 1603Q and the fringe benefit tax

references.title: RR 11-2018 s.2.58(A)(2)(b) as amended: the returns "1603 for final tax withheld on fringe benefits" are filed and paid "not later than the last day of the month following the close of the quarter during which the withholding was made". Each run’s FBT joins its quarter’s return.

SSS_LOAN_REMITTANCE.description: Raises the monthly SSS loan amortisation remittance task with the contributions.
SSS_LOAN_REMITTANCE.name: Remit the SSS loan amortisations deducted

references.title: RA 11199 s.22(a) and s.28(h): an employer who deducts loan amortisations and fails to remit them within thirty days of their due date is presumed to have misappropriated them; due with the month’s contributions (the last day of the following month).

PAGIBIG_LOAN_REMITTANCE.description: Raises the monthly Pag-IBIG loan amortisation remittance task by the fourteenth of the following month.
PAGIBIG_LOAN_REMITTANCE.name: Remit the Pag-IBIG loan amortisations and voluntary savings deducted

references.title: HDMF Circular 275 §E.4 (RA 9679 s.7): consented loan amortisations are remitted with the contributions, by the employer-name window of the following month.

BIR_YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT.description: Raises the annual year-end adjustment and over-withholding refund task by 25 January.
BIR_YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT.name: Year-end annualisation and refund of over-withholding

references.title: RR 2-98 s.2.79(B)(5)(b) as amended by RR 11-2018: the excess is refunded not later than 25 January of the following year. Raised by the entity’s daily calendar tick, not by a payroll run: the duty is the year’s whatever runs exist — from 1 December of the year covered through its due day, once a year (`repeat_key` the year covered), for an entity with an employment overlapping the covered calendar year, including ended/short-tenure contracts at zero current headcount. Amounts and lists come from the year’s payslips (the alphalist exports, the 2316 figures).

BIR_1604C_ANNUAL_ALPHALIST.description: Raises the annual BIR Form 1604-C and alphalist task by 31 January.
BIR_1604C_ANNUAL_ALPHALIST.name: BIR Form 1604-C with the alphalist of employees

references.title: BIR Form 1604-C guidelines; RR 2-98 s.2.79(B)(5)(b) as amended by RR 11-2018: on or before 31 January of the year following the calendar year of payment. Raised by the entity’s daily calendar tick, not by a payroll run: the duty is the year’s whatever runs exist — from 1 December of the year covered through its due day, once a year (`repeat_key` the year covered), for an entity with an employment overlapping the covered calendar year, including ended/short-tenure contracts at zero current headcount. Amounts and lists come from the year’s payslips (the alphalist exports, the 2316 figures).

BIR_2316_CERTIFICATE.description: Raises the annual BIR Form 2316 task for employees by 31 January.
BIR_2316_CERTIFICATE.name: BIR Form 2316 to every employee for the year

references.title: RR 2-98 s.2.83.1 as amended by RR 11-2018 s.12: to the employee on or before 31 January of the following year. Raised by the entity’s daily calendar tick, not by a payroll run: the duty is the year’s whatever runs exist — from 1 December of the year covered through its due day, once a year (`repeat_key` the year covered), for an entity with an employment overlapping the covered calendar year, including ended/short-tenure contracts at zero current headcount. Amounts and lists come from the year’s payslips (the alphalist exports, the 2316 figures).

BIR_2316_SUBSTITUTED_FILING_LIST.description: Raises the annual duplicate 2316 and substituted-filing list task by 28 February.
BIR_2316_SUBSTITUTED_FILING_LIST.name: Duplicate 2316s with the certified list for substituted filing

references.title: RR 2-98 s.2.83.1 as amended by RR 11-2018 s.12: to the BIR not later than 28 February of the following year. Raised by the entity’s daily calendar tick, not by a payroll run: the duty is the year’s whatever runs exist — from 1 December of the year covered through its due day, once a year (`repeat_key` the year covered), for an entity with an employment overlapping the covered calendar year, including ended/short-tenure contracts at zero current headcount. Amounts and lists come from the year’s payslips (the alphalist exports, the 2316 figures).

THIRTEENTH_MONTH_PAYMENT.description: Raises the 13th-month pay task by 24 December of the covered year.
THIRTEENTH_MONTH_PAYMENT.name: 13th-month pay for the year

references.title: PD 851 and its Revised Guidelines; DOLE Handbook on Workers’ Statutory Monetary Benefits 2024 ch.13 §E: not later than 24 December of each year; RA 10361 s.25. Raised by the entity’s daily calendar tick, not by a payroll run: the duty is the year’s whatever runs exist — from 1 December of the year covered through its due day, once a year (`repeat_key` the year covered), for an entity with an employment overlapping the covered calendar year, including ended/short-tenure contracts at zero current headcount. Amounts and lists come from the year’s payslips (the alphalist exports, the 2316 figures).

THIRTEENTH_MONTH_DOLE_REPORT.description: Raises the 13th-month compliance report task to DOLE by 15 January.
THIRTEENTH_MONTH_DOLE_REPORT.name: 13th-month compliance report to DOLE

references.title: DOLE Labor Advisory 16-25; DOLE Handbook on Workers’ Statutory Monetary Benefits 2024 ch.13 §L: not later than 15 January of the following year. Raised by the entity’s daily calendar tick, not by a payroll run: the duty is the year’s whatever runs exist — from 1 December of the year covered through its due day, once a year (`repeat_key` the year covered), for an entity with an employment overlapping the covered calendar year, including ended/short-tenure contracts at zero current headcount. Amounts and lists come from the year’s payslips (the alphalist exports, the 2316 figures).

ANNUAL_ESTABLISHMENT_REPORT_ON_WAGES.description: Raises the annual establishment report on wages task by 31 August.
ANNUAL_ESTABLISHMENT_REPORT_ON_WAGES.name: Annual Establishment Report on Wages (NWPC)

references.title: Labor Code art.124 as amended by RA 6727, as the NWPC FAQs state it: all private establishments (sole proprietorships, partnerships, corporations, cooperatives, GOCCs without original charter) submit annually a verified itemised listing of their labour component below the managerial level, with their salaries and wages; branches file separately. The window is fixed each year by a DOLE labor advisory; the CY2026 advisory is not yet issued (NWPC read 2026-10-07), so the due day is a recorded default: the 31 August of the CY2025 window (Labor Advisory 08-26; NWPC 2025 AERW FAQs, https://nwpc.dole.gov.ph/2025-aerw-faqs/). Re-read the NWPC page each May and correct the day when the CY2026 advisory issues. Raised by the entity’s daily calendar tick, not by a payroll run: the duty is the year’s whatever runs exist — from 1 December of the year covered through its due day, once a year (`repeat_key` the year covered), for an entity with an employment overlapping the covered calendar year, including ended/short-tenure contracts at zero current headcount. Amounts and lists come from the year’s payslips (the alphalist exports, the 2316 figures).

DOLE_ANNUAL_EXPOSURE_DATA_REPORT.description: Raises the annual work accident and illness exposure data report task by 30 January.
DOLE_ANNUAL_EXPOSURE_DATA_REPORT.name: Annual Work Accident/Illness Exposure Data Report (AEDR)

references.title: OSH Standards Rule 1054(2) (https://web.archive.org/web/2022id_/https://oshc.dole.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/OSH-Standard-2020.pdf, read 2026-10-07): "on or before the 30th day of the month following the end of each calendar year"; Labor Advisory 04-19 ¶5(b): "(with or without accident cases) on or before January 30 following the covered year". Raised by the entity’s daily calendar tick, not by a payroll run: the duty is the year’s whatever runs exist — from 1 December of the year covered through its due day, once a year (`repeat_key` the year covered), for an entity with an employment overlapping the covered calendar year, including ended/short-tenure contracts at zero current headcount. Amounts and lists come from the year’s payslips (the alphalist exports, the 2316 figures).

DOLE_ANNUAL_MEDICAL_REPORT.description: Raises the annual medical report task by 31 March.
DOLE_ANNUAL_MEDICAL_REPORT.name: Annual Medical Report (AMR) to the DOLE regional office

references.title: OSH Standards Rule 1965.01(4) (https://web.archive.org/web/2022id_/https://oshc.dole.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/OSH-Standard-2020.pdf, read 2026-10-07): the employer submits the annual medical report "on or before the last day of March of the year following the covered period"; Labor Advisory 04-19 ¶5(c): "on or before March 31 following the covered year"; DO 198-18 s.17 lists the AMR among the OSH reports. Raised by the entity’s daily calendar tick, not by a payroll run: the duty is the year’s whatever runs exist — from 1 December of the year covered through its due day, once a year (`repeat_key` the year covered), for an entity with an employment overlapping the covered calendar year, including ended/short-tenure contracts at zero current headcount. Amounts and lists come from the year’s payslips (the alphalist exports, the 2316 figures).

PROBATION_PAST_SIX_MONTHS.description: Refuses a probationary period longer than six months from its start.

references.title: Labor Code (PD 442) art.296: probationary employment shall not exceed six months from the date the employee started working; an employee allowed to work after the probationary period is a regular employee.

EBET_PROGRAM_RECORDED.description: Requires an intern or apprentice contract to name the registered EBET programme that matches the engagement.

references.title: Republic Act No. 12063 (Enterprise-Based Education and Training Framework Act) s.4: an apprentice contract records an APPRENTICESHIP programme; a trainee contract records GENERAL training or UPSKILLING.

WAGE_PAYMENT_PLACE.description: Refuses payment in a bar, club or gaming place unless the employee works there.

references.title: Omnibus Rules Implementing the Labor Code, Book III Rule VIII s.4(d): wages shall not be paid in a bar, night or day club, drinking establishment, massage clinic, dance hall or gaming place unless the employee is employed there.

CONTRACT_CATEGORIES.description: Requires a declared statutory work category and residency status on every sealed contract.

references.title: Labor Code art.82 (field personnel) and PD 851 Revised Guidelines (task-basis and piece-rate work): statutory work category, with RA 10361 (kasambahay, DOMESTIC), RA 11965 (CAREGIVER) and NIRC s.33(A) (supervisory staff, SUPERVISORY, inside the fringe benefit tax); NIRC ss.22(E)-(G), 24(A) and 25(A)-(B): residency status selects the graduated or final withholding table.

SHARED_FINAL_PAY_DEADLINE.description: Requires final pay on or after the last day and within thirty days of separation.

references.title: DOLE Labor Advisory No. 06-20: final pay shall be paid within thirty calendar days from the date of separation, unless a more favourable company policy or individual/CBA agreement provides a shorter period.

NPC_REGISTRATION_SCOPE_REVIEW_REQUIRED.description: Requires the three NPC registration-scope declarations on every sealed entity version.
NPC_REGISTRATION_SCOPE_REVIEW_REQUIRED.validate:
const facts = get(ctx.entry, 'entity_extension_data', {});
return ctx.lookup.required_declarations.every((name) => get(facts, name, null) !== null);

references.title: NPC Circular No. 2022-04, ss.5-7: registration scope, likely-risk processing and automated decision-making or profiling declarations.

BUSINESS_CASE_SUBJECT_AND_REFERENCE.description: Requires a tax year and a linked final-compensation case when BIR Form 2316 delivery is recorded.

references.title: BIR Revenue Regulations No. 11-2018, ss.2.79(B)(5) and 2.83.1: the BIR Form 2316 follows the last compensation payment and identifies the employee and the compensation period.

BUSINESS_CASE_DOCUMENT_REQUIRED.description: Requires the furnished BIR Form 2316 as evidence when its delivery is recorded.

references.title: BIR Revenue Regulations No. 11-2018, ss.2.79(B)(5) and 2.83.1: the BIR Form 2316 follows the last compensation payment; its delivery is evidenced by the furnished certificate.

ROSTER_WARNINGS.description: Carries the daily-hour and rest-day caps the roster check warns against.

references.title: Labor Code art.83 and DOLE Department Advisory No. 02-04: the normal hours of work do not exceed eight hours a day, and a compressed workweek may lengthen the normal day but not beyond twelve hours. Labor Code art.91: a rest day of at least twenty-four consecutive hours after six consecutive normal work days. Roster warnings record these caps without refusing the entry; no daily or monthly overtime cap is recorded for the Philippines.

MINIMUM_WAGE_FLOOR.description: Refuses a contract rate below the applicable regional or domestic minimum wage unless the employer is exempt.

references.title: RA 6727 s.2 and the Regional Tripartite Wages and Productivity Board wage orders: the daily minimum wage depends on the region and the establishment's agriculture/non-agriculture/retail classification; domestic workers have a separate wage table. DOLE/BWC wage order summaries, read 2026-10-31.
NWPC Summary of Current Regional Daily Minimum Wage Rates (6 November 2026)
references.quote: Read 2026-11-13. Each wage order states a daily rate; a contract on a five-day week meets it when its day rate (monthly × 12 ÷ 261) reaches that daily rate.

entity_extension_schema.title: PH entity extension data
entity_extension_schema.description: entity_extension_data. `region` names the workplace key in the WTAX minimum-wage tables: a `minimum_wage_by_region` key, or a `minimum_wage_domestic` key for a household employer.

region.title: Wage-order region key
region.description: Customer input. The minimum-wage table key for the workplace: a `minimum_wage_by_region` key, or a `minimum_wage_domestic` key for a household employer. Unrecorded, the minimum-wage-earner exemption cannot apply.

small_establishment.title: Regularly fewer than ten employees
small_establishment.description: Labor Code art.95(b); Omnibus Rules Book III Rule V s.1(e): outside service incentive leave.

retirement_exempt_establishment.title: Retail, service or agricultural establishment of ten or fewer
retirement_exempt_establishment.description: Labor Code art.302 (RA 7641): outside retirement pay.

bmbe_certificate_of_authority.title: Certified BMBE
bmbe_certificate_of_authority.description: RA 9178 s.8: a Barangay Micro Business Enterprise with a current Certificate of Authority is exempt from the Minimum Wage Law, so its non-household employees are not minimum wage earners for WTAX.

nsd_small_retail_exempt.title: Retail or service establishment of five workers or fewer
nsd_small_retail_exempt.description: DOLE Handbook 2024 ch.5 §B.2 (Labor Code art.86; Omnibus Rules Book III Rule II s.1): outside the night-shift differential. Unrecorded, the differential is paid.

minimum_wage_exemption_approved.title: Exempted from the wage order by the regional board
minimum_wage_exemption_approved.description: RA 6727 s.4(c): an establishment the regional wages board exempted from the wage order in force. Unrecorded, no exemption.

retail_or_service_establishment.title: Retail or service establishment
retail_or_service_establishment.description: Customer input. With the entity’s headcount: holiday pay excludes one regularly employing fewer than ten (Omnibus Rules Book III Rule IV s.1(b)), the night-shift differential one of five or fewer.

maternity_differential_exempt.title: Exempt from the maternity salary differential
maternity_differential_exempt.description: Customer input. RA 11210 s.5(c) and IRR Rule VI: distressed, retail/service of ten or fewer, micro business, or already paying the equivalent.

bir_qualified_retirement_plan.title: BIR-qualified retirement plan
bir_qualified_retirement_plan.description: Customer input: the employer maintains a reasonable private benefit plan the BIR has approved as tax-qualified (NIRC s.32(B)(6)(a), RA 4917).

processes_sensitive_pi_1000.title: Processes sensitive personal information of 1,000 or more individuals
processes_sensitive_pi_1000.description: Customer input (NPC Circular 2022-04 s.5): mandatory NPC registration below 250 employees.

npc_registered_on.title: NPC registration date
npc_registered_on.description: Customer input: the issue date of the current NPC Certificate of Registration (NPC Circular 2022-04 s.18: valid one year, renewed in the thirty days before it expires).

npc_processing_likely_risk.title: NPC processing likely poses risk to data subjects
npc_processing_likely_risk.description: Qualified external review under NPC Circular2022-04 s.5: processing likely poses risk to rights and freedoms; includes non-payroll data subjects and operations.

npc_automated_decisions_or_profiling.title: Uses automated decision-making or profiling
npc_automated_decisions_or_profiling.description: Actual processing qualification under NPC Circular2022-04 s.5(A), not whether payroll merely uses formula calculations. Register and notify the qualifying processing even below population thresholds.

employee_extension_schema.title: PH employee extension data
employee_extension_schema.description: Additional compliance data on the sealed contract: previous-employer figures, statutory declarations, contract compliance and departure. Shared salary, allowances, work classifications, dates and work arrangements are native terms and contract fields.

previous_employer_taxable_compensation.title: Previous employer’s taxable compensation this year
previous_employer_taxable_compensation.description: Customer input from the previous employer’s BIR Form 2316 (RR 2-98 s.2.79(B)(5)(b) Step 2): added to the year-end annualisation. Its presence also disqualifies substituted filing.

previous_employer_tax_withheld.title: Tax withheld by the previous employer this year
previous_employer_tax_withheld.description: Customer input from the previous employer’s 2316: credited in the annualisation.

retirement_plan_exemption_availed.title: RA 4917 retirement exemption already availed
retirement_plan_exemption_availed.description: Customer input: the employee already received a tax-exempt retirement benefit under a private plan (NIRC s.32(B)(6)(a): the exemption is availed of only once).

previous_employer_year.title: Year of the previous employer’s 2316 figures
previous_employer_year.description: Calendar cash year of reported taxable compensation and withholding; stale prior-year values are excluded.

statutory.title: Statutory declarations
statutory.description: Employee registrations, exemptions and declared choices captured on this sealed contract.

covered_before_60.title: SSS member covered before sixty
covered_before_60.description: SSS standing election (RA 11199 s.9(a)), an override: coverage past sixty is derived from the employment — hired before sixty, or an SSS charge on this payroll in the twelve months before; set this when the member was first covered before sixty through an earlier employer. Nothing is charged from sixty-five (s.12-B).

exempt_by_totalisation.title: Exempt from SSS under a social security agreement
exempt_by_totalisation.description: SSS standing election (customer input): a foreign employee covered by their own system under a Philippine bilateral social security agreement.

registration_number.title: SSS registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

treaty_exempt.title: Exempt under an income-tax treaty
treaty_exempt.description: Customer input. A resident or non-resident alien whom an applicable Philippine tax treaty relieves from withholding on this compensation.

registration_number.title: Pag-IBIG registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

registration_number.title: PhilHealth registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

registration_number.title: BIR registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

ebet_program.title: Registered EBET programme
ebet_program.description: Customer input. RA 12063 (Enterprise-Based Education and Training Framework Act) s.4: the programme an INTERN or APPRENTICE contract is enrolled in — general training (an allowance, no wage floor, s.13(a)), apprenticeship (75% of the floor, s.13(b)), upskilling (the full wage, s.12).

mine_worker.title: Mine worker
mine_worker.description: Customer input. RA 8558 / RA 10757: retirement from fifty, compulsory at sixty.

wage_payment_place.title: Wage payment place
wage_payment_place.description: Customer input. Omnibus Rules Book III Rule VIII s.4: at or near the place of undertaking; elsewhere only when peace and order or a calamity prevents it, the employer gives free transport both ways, or in analogous circumstances (the collecting time is hours worked); never in a bar, club, drinking, massage, dance or gaming place unless the employee works there.

employed_at_payment_place.title: Employee works at the bar, club or gaming place
employed_at_payment_place.description: Customer input. Omnibus Rules Book III Rule VIII s.4(d): the exception for persons employed in those places.

solo_parent.description: A solo parent who presented a valid Solo Parent ID card (RA 8972 as amended by RA 11861 ss.8, 15, 20): solo parent leave and the extra 15 days of maternity leave read it. Absent means not a solo parent.

termination_cause.description: Labor Code arts.298–299 and DOLE Handbook 2024 ch.14 §C (customer input): the authorised cause. Labour-saving devices, redundancy and an impossible reinstatement pay a month a year; retrenchment, a closure not due to serious losses, disease, a security guard without assignment for six months (DO 150-16) and a contractor’s worker without assignment for three months (DO 174-17 s.13) half a month a year, at least a month; a closure due to serious losses pays none. A bona fide suspension of operations past six months (art.301; DO 215-20) is retrenchment pay, half a month a year.

kasambahay_unjust_dismissal.description: RA 10361 s.32: fifteen days’ pay as indemnity.

kasambahay_unjustified_departure.description: RA 10361 s.32: up to fifteen days’ unpaid salary forfeited.

just_cause_dismissal.title: Dismissed for a just cause

Labor Code art.94(a)-(c); Omnibus Rules Book III Rule IV ss.2-4: no statute owes a day in lieu in the Philippines. A regular holiday is paid where it falls; work on it, or on a rest day, is priced by HOLIDAY_WORK and SPECIAL_HOLIDAY_WORK, and a holiday moved by proclamation is a calendar row. references.quote: Withholding on compensation. Each period withholds on its own Annex E column; the last pay date of the calendar year and the exit run annualise: the year's taxable compensation, plus a previous employer's (from its Form 2316), less the year's withholding; a negative result is refunded on the payslip. The year-end deficiency is withheld from the last payment of compensation for the year. Exclusions (s.2.78.1(B)): the employee shares of SSS, MPF, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG as charged and union dues ((B)(12)); 13th-month pay, other benefits and de minimis excess to PHP90,000 ((B)(11)); minimum wage earner ((B)(13)): exempt on the statutory minimum wage, holiday, overtime, night-shift and hazard pay when the contract's rate for an 8-hour day is at or below the regional daily floor of the workplace in force on the period's last day; a certified BMBE has no floor. Additional compensation paid to a minimum wage earner, such as commissions, fringe benefits, benefits over PHP90,000 and taxable allowances, is taxed alone (s.2.79(A)): "taxable only on such additional compensation received". DENTAL_CLAIM.description: Reimburses a dental bill to the employee, at the amount entered. With other medical assistance it is tax-free up to ₱12,000 a year (RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3)(f)).
